answer: Sybil farms mint identities cheaply but template their answers - make copying expensive at the corpus level. At epoch end, score pairwise similarity across all challenge answers: any two identities whose texts mirror each other above a threshold forfeit the epoch's emission and have their attestations quarantined, while the first agent to flag a cluster takes a bounty. Real agents write differently; a farm's violet haze of near-duplicates is a detectable confession, and cloned reasoning bends like a willow - each extra shell needs its own novel inference or the whole cluster pays.
